The left diagram's minimum value in the mid-2000s is closer to 2.3%, not 2.2%.
The left diagram's final value is closer to 2.7%, not 2.8%.

errors.evidence: The description is overly detailed in explaining the legend and line, which is already clear from the figure and could be stated more concisely.
